external_entities.name: developer
external_entities.description: A developer who pushes branches and can manually initiate a rebuild of main.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: The public package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: git server
processes.description: A self-hosted Git server receiving developer branches and providing source for builds; it sits on the corporate network.
processes.source_excerpt: our self-hosted git server, which sits on the corporate network

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: A runner that fetches source, resolves the dependency lockfile, produces container images, pushes images, calls the deploy controller, and can be manually used to rebuild main.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: The runner uses a shared build token.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: A controller that stores which image SHA the estate should use and responds to release queries from store servers.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.

processes.name: store server
processes.description: A small server in each store back office running the till software as a container; it polls for the current release, pulls images, and restarts the container when needed.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.
processes.notes: Represents the store-server fleet of about 1,200 stores.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: Software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: running the till software as a container

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: A registry in the build environment that stores finished container images tagged with commit SHAs and allows store servers to pull them.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: git server
data_stores.description: The self-hosted Git server where developer branches and source are stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the git server encrypts what it stores.

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: Developer pushes branches to the Git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: Build runner fetches source from the Git server for a build.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source

data_flows.name: push image
data_flows.description: Build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: finished container image tagged with the commit SHA

data_flows.name: set current release
data_flows.description: Build runner asks the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release
data_flows.data_description: image SHA for the current release

data_flows.name: query current release
data_flows.description: Store server asks the deploy controller for the current release once a minute.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: Store server pulls the current container image from the image registry when its release differs.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it pulls that image from the registry and restarts the container
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: Build runner reaches out to the public package registry while resolving dependencies.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: kick off rebuild
data_flows.description: Developer logs in to the build runner and manually kicks off a rebuild of main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the Git server and deploy controller run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: which sits on the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: build environment
trust_boundaries.description: The separate environment where the build runner and image registry run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The runner lives in its own build environment, separate from the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: store estate
trust_boundaries.description: The estate containing the store servers across about 1,200 stores.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The image registry is reachable from the store estate over the WAN.

trust_boundaries.name: retail WAN
trust_boundaries.description: The WAN over which traffic between the stores and the corporate network travels.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Traffic between the stores and the corporate network goes over the retail WAN.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network location of the public package registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the public package registry on the internet
